title: Customer 360: an account page built from your own content
description: One page per account — status, risks, and a drill-in chat — assembled from whatever your instance already knows about that customer. No CRM export, no separate index.
prerequisites: Path A: a Glean API token with SEARCH and CHAT scopes
Path B: a Glean API token with SEARCH and AGENTS scopes (tiles still use Platform Search)
X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL=true (Platform Search, Chat, and Agents are experimental)
Path B: an Account Brief agent in Agent Builder; set GLEAN_AGENT_ID server-side
An account name your own content covers — the page is built around whichever you pick (GLEAN_ACCOUNT_NAME)

demoQueries.query: What's the status of our renewal with that account?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a non-empty answer citing real documents about the account you built the page around. Substitute the name when you ask — there is no fixed query text for a page built around whichever account you pick.
Synthesizes across more than one source with a citation per claim, rather than restating a single document.

Either names risks grounded in cited content, or says it has none to report. It must not infer risk the sources don't support, and the KPI header must leave unsupported fields blank rather than showing a figure no document contains.

codeAssets.description: Path A — parallel Platform Search tiles + Platform Chat synthesis

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: Fill in GLEAN_API_TOKEN, GLEAN_SERVER_URL, and GLEAN_ACCOUNT_NAME. The app runs as you; there is no act-as.

steps.title: Run it
steps.description: Leaves the server running so you can try it yourself at http://localhost:3000 — stop it (Ctrl-C) before the verify step below, which starts its own instance.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Loads credentials from .env (same as npm start), runs the demo queries against the account you picked, and asserts cited answers with blank unsupported KPI fields. Do not report this recipe as done until this passes.

codeAssets.description: Path B — Platform Agents createRun for prescriptive account briefs

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: Fill in GLEAN_API_TOKEN, GLEAN_SERVER_URL, GLEAN_ACCOUNT_NAME, and GLEAN_AGENT_ID (Account Brief agent). The app runs as you; there is no act-as.

steps.title: Run it
steps.description: Leaves the server running so you can try it yourself at http://localhost:3000 — stop it (Ctrl-C) before the verify step below, which starts its own instance.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Loads credentials from .env (same as npm start), runs the demo queries against your Account Brief agent, and asserts cited answers (or an explicit failure if the agent is missing or unauthorized). Do not report this recipe as done until this passes.

steps.title: Pick a path
steps.description: Path A (Platform Search + Chat) builds an open-ended explorable dashboard: parallel search.query tiles and POST /api/chat for journey summary and saved prompts. Path B (Platform Agents) keeps the same page UX but runs synthesis through glean.agents.createRun against a template Account Brief agent.

aiPrompt:
Build a Customer 360 account page following
https://developers.glean.com/cookbook/customer-360

1. Ask me which path: (A) Platform Search + Chat or (B) Platform Agents.
   Build the one I pick. Do NOT use Client API chat.create, client.search.query,
   or client.agents.run.
2. Ask me which account to build around and which of my sources cover
   it. Read every figure from retrieval -- ARR, seat count, renewal
   date, risk -- and leave a field blank when nothing supports it.
   Never display a number the sources do not contain.
3. Path A: parallel glean.search.query for account notes / renewal / security
   tiles; journey + prompts + follow-ups via server-side POST /api/chat with
   { input, stream: false, store: true } and X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL.
   Parse output_text + annotations[].sources[]. Keep the token server-side.
4. Path B: same page UX; synthesis via glean.agents.createRun({ messages,
   stream: false }, GLEAN_AGENT_ID). Document Agent Builder Account Brief
   prereq. Failure UX if agent missing/unauthorized.
5. Empty tiles read "no recent activity", not "0". An empty retrieval
   is a state to render, not a gap to fill. HTTP 200 with no answer
   text is a failure to retry, not a blank success.
6. Style it per the house style below: the real Glean logomark, Glean
   Blue (#343ced) as the accent.
7. Verify with the demo queries against the account I chose.
llmContext: Platform-only recipe. Search: glean.search.query -> POST /api/search, results[].title/url/snippets (string[]). Chat: fetch POST /api/chat (until glean.chat.create ships); request {input, stream:false, store:true}; response output[].content[] type=output_text with annotations[].sources[]. Agents: glean.agents.createRun(request, agentId) -> POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/runs; stream:false returns PlatformAgentRunWaitResponse synchronously (no polling); messages use role USER|GLEAN_AI and content[{text,type:text}]. Experimental opt-in via X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL. Do NOT teach glean.client.chat.create, glean.client.search.query, or glean.client.agents.run. Auth is the caller's own token; impersonation/act-as was removed from the cookbook recipes. Tokens server-side only. The account and every figure on the page come from the reader's own instance. Nothing may hardcode an account name, owner, ARR, seat count or renewal date: an earlier version returned a fixed demo account on the live path, so the KPI header showed one fictional customer's numbers whatever retrieval returned. Use GLEAN_SERVER_URL rather than deriving the backend from an instance name, and GLEAN_ACCOUNT_NAME for the account. This recipe does not depend on examples/sample-catalog.
